Number of researchers assigned to Team B = (50 – 20) = 30. To find the least possible number of researchers who will not be assigned to the team they prefer, we assume that the maximum number of researchers get the team they prefer. So, number of researchers who are assigned to the team they prefer = 20 (Team A) + 15 (Team B) = 35. \ Required number = (50 – 35) = 15.
